receiver: rn's makers, reading the issue on lovaizu/ccpm, who build rn for all its users
use: deciding how rn changes so that every user's later work meets the need

questions.question: The learning only says what happened: turn:up's hook refused to start a run with 'lane cannot check read_only on step 4 of up: {given} is not given in what up started from', and the same call sent again ran. It does not say what should change, and the hook belongs to turn, whose files the issue's readers are not given beside rn's. So the issue cannot yet say what rn's makers should change, or keep to one change. Which change should the issue ask for? (a) turn:up's hook should let a run's first start through, as it lets the same call through when sent again: a change to turn, named as met where step 3 of /rn:up (rn/skills/up/SKILL.md) starts turn:up. (b) Step 3 of /rn:up should start turn:up again with the same call when it refuses to start. (c) Both, as two separate issues.
questions.recommended: (a), because the cause is in turn's hook, and a retry in rn's step 3 would only hide it while every other caller of turn still meets the refusal.
